title: 阿卡丽·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 高束深色马尾，绿色蒙面布与绿紫服饰形成利落的色彩层次。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Akali is an adult Ionian ninja with a high dark ponytail, focused eyes, a green cloth face covering, and recognizable green-purple costume accents. Preserve her lean athletic adult proportions while fully covering her torso with a fitted long-sleeved ninja jacket, opaque trousers, wraps, gloves, and boots. Her curved kama hangs motionless beside the leg, and her kunai remains securely sheathed.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: jade, plum shadow, pale limestone, warm gold light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
